annotations.title: Save a note the person asked for about their job search

description: Save a note the person asked for about their job search. Only when the person says so, for example "remember I want to move into management". The note is shown to them in get_about_me, is used only to rank and write their own applications, and can be confirmed with confirm_note or deleted with delete_note at any time. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.
name: note_about_me
